stories.title: Nearly 4,700 people in Flintshire and Wrexham turned to Citizens Advice last year
stories.summary: Citizens Advice Flintshire and Citizens Advice Wrexham supported 4,657 people with more than 23,000 separate issues over the course of a year, the two charities have said. The problems people brought to them covered debt, benefits, employment and housing. The figures were set out during a visit to the charity’s Deeside office by Marc Jones

stories.title: Rare bush dog pups emerge at Chester Zoo after 65-day pregnancy
stories.summary: Five bush dog pups have come out of their den at Chester Zoo for the first time, and the zoo says they are the only ones born in the UK this year. They were born around a month ago to four-year-old Molly, after a 65-day pregnancy, and are now moving around the enclosure alongside dad

stories.title: Road safety groups press UK Government on alcohol interlocks for repeat drink-drive offenders
stories.summary: Police chiefs, police and crime commissioners and the RAC have asked the Prime Minister to give courts the power to stop convicted drink-drivers starting their cars. The request is set out in an open letter to Andy Burnham signed by ten organisations and individuals, including the RAC, the road safety charity Brake, the Royal Society

stories.title: Former police officer turned Flintshire MS opposes handing control of policing to Welsh Government
stories.summary: A Flintshire based politician who served with North Wales Police has rejected the case for handing control of policing to the Welsh Government, after the region’s police and crime commissioner cautiously backed the idea.
